resources.name: OpenMC Monte Carlo particle transport code

access.notes: Install via pip: pip install openmc. Requires nuclear cross-section data (see nuclear_data).

resources.notes: Open-source Monte Carlo code; alternative tools like Geant4 or FLUKA are also acceptable.

resources.name: ENDF/B-VIII.0 nuclear data library

access.notes: Can be downloaded using OpenMC's 'openmc-get-data' script or manually from the OpenMC data page. Contains neutron cross sections and gamma production data for lead and other materials.

resources.notes: Neutron and gamma interaction data for Monte Carlo simulations.
